note: Credit and provenance for every file under ui/assets-gothic/. The gothic concept and all of its artwork was generated with ChatGPT (OpenAI) across several sessions, for the Pilgrim project. No third party requires attribution, but the record is kept in the same machine-readable shape as ui/assets/attribution.json so the same tooling can read it. Do not describe any of this artwork as manually illustrated.
reproducibility: The originals cannot be regenerated. They came out of ChatGPT sessions with no prompt or seed on record, and image generation is not deterministic anyway, so a lost original is lost -- asking again produces different artwork, not the same artwork. Files marked reproducibleBy can be rebuilt from the originals by that script; everything else is an original in its own right and its only copy is the one in this repository.

ui/panorama.webp.title: Pilgrim trail at night, two-part panorama behind the game view
ui/panorama.webp.creator: Generated with ChatGPT (OpenAI)
ui/panorama.webp.source: two halves generated in a ChatGPT session for this project from the left-half and right-half panorama prompts; no upstream URL, no seed on record
ui/panorama.webp.role: KEPT, NOT DRAWN: the darker night field the wheel was originally composed against and every measurement in ui/README.md was taken over. gen_panorama.SETS still builds it and its guard still holds it byte-identical, so the two can be compared rather than remembered. the field behind the whole game view, painted on html,body so it fills the viewport; the stage is transparent over it, so this also shows through the duty wheel's channels and every gutter
ui/panorama.webp.modifications: joined by ui/render/gen_panorama.py from the two halves under ui/sources/: de-vignetted at both inner edges, then level-matched per channel with the correction faded out over the first quarter of the right half. Butt-joined with no overlap -- an overlap costs width, and restoring 2.600:1 then costs height at 2.6 px of overlap per px of height. Seam step after both corrections is 0.00 levels at 1, 4, 16 and 64 columns either side. Encoded to WebP at quality 86. The script is the statement of what was done; this is the summary of it.
ui/panorama.webp.reproducibleBy: python3 ui/render/gen_panorama.py -- byte-identical to the committed file from the two committed halves; `--check` asserts it. The HALVES are not reproducible; the join is.

ui/panorama_clearing.webp.modifications: joined by ui/render/gen_panorama.py --set clearing from the two halves under ui/sources/: de-vignetted at both inner edges, then level-matched per channel with the correction faded out over the first quarter of the right half. Butt-joined with no overlap. Seam step after both corrections is at most 0.16 levels at 1, 4, 16 and 64 columns either side. Encoded to WebP at quality 86.
ui/panorama_clearing.webp.reproducibleBy: python3 ui/render/gen_panorama.py --set clearing -- byte-identical to the committed file from the two committed halves; `--check` asserts it. The HALVES are not reproducible; the join is.
